title: FaceBlur audit.jsonl line
description: One line of audit.jsonl, the record of one privacy desensitization run. The file is append-only JSONL. Each line is canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces, ASCII) and is chained to the line before it: `hash` is sha256(prev + canonical(line without hash)), and `prev` is the previous line's `hash` (64 zeros on the first line). Editing, removing or reordering any line breaks every hash after it. A file holds exactly one header (seq 0), then frame, speech and camera_done lines, then at most one footer, last.

type.description: What this line records: header (the run's inputs and models), frame (what was removed from one video frame), speech (one stretch of speech in the removed audio), camera_done (summary of one camera), footer (the output and how the run ended).

oneOf.title: header
oneOf.description: First line of every file (seq 0): what went in and what processed it.

input_sha256.description: sha256 of the input episode file, so the record can be matched to the original that was processed.

input_name.description: File name of the input episode (no directory).

cameras.description: Names of the camera streams found in the input, in processing order.

models.description: Every model used, mapped from its name to the sha256 of its weights file, so the exact detectors can be identified later.

settings.description: The full detection and blur settings of the run (free form; the tool's Settings object as a dict).

image_digest.description: Digest of the container image the run executed in, or null when it ran outside a container.

tool_version.description: Version of the FaceBlur tool that wrote this record.

oneOf.title: frame
oneOf.description: What was found and blurred in one video frame of one camera.

camera.description: Name of the camera stream the frame belongs to.

frame.description: Zero-based index of the frame in its camera stream.

pts_ns.description: Presentation timestamp of the frame in nanoseconds.

counts.description: Number of regions of each class blurred in this frame. Every class is present; 0 means looked for and none found.

boxes.description: Axis-aligned boxes of the blurred regions, per class. A class may be absent when it has none.

quads.description: Optional rotated outlines for classes detected as quadrilaterals (text, plates): per class, a list of four corners.

oneOf.title: speech
oneOf.description: One stretch of speech found in the input audio. The output carries no audio; these lines record what was removed.

start_s.description: Start of the speech in seconds from the start of the audio, padding included.

end_s.description: End of the speech in seconds from the start of the audio, padding included.

pad_ms.description: Milliseconds of padding added on each side of the detected speech.

oneOf.title: camera_done
oneOf.description: Summary written when one camera stream has been fully processed.

frames.description: Number of frames processed in this camera.

seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds spent processing this camera.

record.description: The per-file audit of this camera (faceblur.pipeline.AuditRecord as a dict): detection, tracking and mask-coverage statistics. Free form.

oneOf.title: footer
oneOf.description: Last line of a finished run: what came out and how the run ended. A file without a footer is from a run that did not finish.

output_sha256.description: sha256 of the de-identified output episode file.

output_name.description: File name of the output episode (no directory).

status.description: How the run ended, for example ok or failed.

error.description: Error message when the run failed; empty otherwise.

sha256.description: A sha256 digest as 64 lowercase hex characters.

seq.description: Position of the line in the file, 0 for the header, increasing by 1 per line.

prev.description: The `hash` of the previous line; 64 zeros on the first line.

hash.description: sha256 of `prev` (as ASCII) followed by the canonical JSON of this line without its `hash` field.

time.description: UTC time the line was written, ISO 8601 to the second with Z, e.g. 2026-11-05T09:30:00Z.

box.description: [x, y, w, h] in pixels of the full frame, top-left origin, rounded to 0.1.

boxes.description: A list of [x, y, w, h] boxes.

quad.description: Four corners of a rotated region, in order around its outline.
